title: DriveSure Benefits Summary: Towing, Rental, Trip Interruption and Roadside Assistance
content:
Vehicle Service Contracts reimburse towing, rental and trip interruption costs connected with a covered breakdown, in the amounts below for each DriveSure plan; most plans also include 24-hour roadside assistance.

| Plan | Towing per covered breakdown (USD) | Rental per day while a covered repair is in progress (USD) | Maximum rental days per covered repair | Trip interruption (USD) | 24-hour roadside assistance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DriveSure Powertrain | 100.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 | 0.00 (none) | Not included |
| DriveSure Powertrain Plus | 100.00 | 30.00 | 5 | 0.00 (none) | Included |
| DriveSure Silver | 100.00 | 35.00 | 5 | 250.00 | Included |
| DriveSure Gold | 150.00 | 40.00 | 7 | 500.00 | Included |
| DriveSure Platinum | 150.00 | 45.00 | 7 | 500.00 | Included |
| DriveSure Exclusionary | 200.00 | 50.00 | 10 | 750.00 | Included |

**What each benefit is.**

- Towing: towing reimbursement per covered breakdown, in USD.
- Rental: rental reimbursement per day while a covered repair is in progress, in USD, for at most the plan's maximum rental days per covered repair; 0.00 means none.
- Trip interruption: lodging and meals reimbursement when a covered breakdown occurs more than 100 miles from home, in USD; 0.00 means none.
- Roadside assistance: whether 24-hour roadside assistance is included.

**Illustration (hypothetical repair).** A covered repair under DriveSure Silver that keeps the vehicle at the facility for eight days carries rental reimbursement of 35.00 per day for at most 5 days, which is 175.00; under DriveSure Powertrain the same repair carries no rental reimbursement.
